candidates.name: Optic Neuritis
support_spans: Relative afferent pupil defect
Central scotoma
Impaired color and contrast vision
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms, such as blurred vision and redness in the right eye, are consistent with optic neuritis.

candidates.name: Retinal Vasculitis
support_spans: Fluorescein leakage from retinal venules inferotemporal to the macula
candidates.why: The fluorescein angiography results show fluorescein leakage from retinal venules, which is consistent with retinal vasculitis.

candidates.name: COVID-19
support_spans: Positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2
candidates.why: The patient's recent close contact with a fatal case and positive RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2 suggest a possible link between COVID-19 and the patient's symptoms.

candidates.name: Viral Retinitis
support_spans: Negative IgM and very weakly positive IgG for VZV, HSV, EBV, and CMV
candidates.why: The patient's serology results show weakly positive IgG for various viruses, which could suggest a viral etiology for the retinitis.

candidates.name: SARS-CoV-2 Retinopathy
support_spans: Positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2
Fluorescein leakage from retinal venules inferotemporal to the macula
candidates.why: The combination of positive RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2 and fluorescein angiography results showing retinal vasculitis could suggest a decisive diagnosis of SARS-CoV-2 retinopathy.
